description: The saltbox's two sloped edges are parallel and face each other: their wavefront edges reach one line at the same elevation, cover it once in each direction, and close up together with the gables between them (16.4.4) - here at a 6 in 12 front and a 2 in 12 back, the ridge 6 feet from the front of a house 24 feet deep and 3 feet above the eave.
